# A Reading List That Stays Useful

## The problem
This fictional project asks how a saved article can be easier to find again.

## The decision
Keep a small list with a short note explaining why each article matters.

## Verification
Try the workflow with invented records, check direct navigation, and document what should be tested next. No real users or measured business results are claimed.
